criteria.name: Introduction: mission concept and rationale. Include the following required information: What is the spacecraft's primary mission? Why is the mission needed? How many spacecraft are used and why? Who are the users (operator and customers)?
criteria.reasoning: Primary mission, rationale (monitoring Great Barrier Reef bleaching via fluid lensing), and constellation size (1 spacecraft) are clearly stated. However, specific users, including commercial/government operators and paying customers, are vaguely addressed.

evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.

Why did you choose this option? What type of orbit will you use? What are its characteristics and orbital elements? Will you need to perform any orbital maneuvers? Which ground control facilities will you use? How often will your spacecraft be able to communicate with ground control? How long will the mission last, and what are your plans for EOL?

criteria.reasoning: The conclusion summarizes the main body findings but remains fairly generic and reiterates basic design choices without addressing limitations or technical trade-offs.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: The layout has standard headings and STK visuals, but suffers from broken text (e.g. cut-off sentence in EOL), malformed bibliography entries, and explicitly prohibited sources (Wikipedia cited as source [6]).

evidence.quote: It acts like a regular sail, utilising a large surface area to ‘ and is suitable for low-earth orbit altitudes [10].

technical_issues.issue: Stated Kourou latitude as 45.05°N instead of ~5.23°N.
Incorrect SSO inclination: 87.79° is prograde; a 600 km circular SSO requires approximately 97.79° retrograde inclination (even though MATLAB plot correctly shows ~97.8°).
Sentence terminates prematurely in the drag sail description.

overall: The submission addresses most rubric requirements, applying STK analysis to launch, ground passes, and orbits for an Australian reef-monitoring mission. However, serious technical mistakes (wrong launch site latitude, prograde inclination for SSO) and formatting/referencing flaws (incomplete sentences, Wikipedia citation) reduce the technical quality to an adequate standard.

feedback.summary: You developed a solid concept for reef monitoring with effective STK coverage and ground station analyses. However, critical orbital calculation errors, launch site discrepancies, and unfinished text kept the work at an Adequate level. To reach Accomplished, ensure all orbital parameters are physically accurate and consistent, explicitly identify end-users, and proofread carefully to eliminate truncated sentences and informal references.
next_steps: Correct the orbital mechanics in the Orbit section: recalculate the sun-synchronous inclination to the retrograde value (~97.8°), aligning your text with your MATLAB figure.
Verify geographical parameters across the report, correcting Kourou’s latitude from 45.05°N to approximately 5.23°N.
Replace non-peer-reviewed sources such as Wikipedia with authoritative aerospace references and complete all truncated sentences before submission.

criteria.C1: You clearly established the reef-monitoring mission and single-satellite rationale. To reach Accomplished, explicitly differentiate the operational entities and paying customers rather than referencing marine scientists broadly.
criteria.C2: Your STK simulation provided good access insight. However, stating a prograde 87.79° inclination for an SSO, misidentifying Kourou's latitude, and truncating the drag sail discussion in Mission Duration & EOL limited the score. Ensure technical calculations and parameters are verified and consistent.
criteria.C3: You successfully summarized the main mission parameters. To achieve Accomplished, write a detailed conclusion that evaluates mission trade-offs, limitations, and operational feasibility rather than generic reiterations.
criteria.C4: The document followed a logical layout with helpful plots. To attain Accomplished, repair incomplete sentences such as the drag sail description, correct bibliography formatting, and replace Wikipedia citations with peer-reviewed literature.
